source_text:
Ἀκολούθως τούτοις ἐξεταστέον τί τό· Ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.

χαίρει μὲν ὁ σπείρων ὅτι τὰ σπέρματα αὐτοῦ ηὔξηται, χαίρει δὲ ὁ θερίζων ὅτι συνάγει τὸν καρπόν.
pass_a_gloss: Following these things one must examine what the “In order that the one sowing together may rejoice and the one harvesting” is. The one sowing rejoices on the one hand that his seeds have grown, and the one harvesting rejoices that he gathers the fruit.
pass_b_english: Next examine [[“so that the sower and reaper may rejoice together.” >> Bible:John 4:36]]
The sower rejoices that his seeds have grown; the reaper rejoices that he gathers the fruit.
